# DripDome

> DripDome is a women-owned set design and custom fabrication studio based in New York City with a second presence in Los Angeles. The studio designs, fabricates, and installs permanent podcast studios, brand activations, pop-ups, and immersive environments entirely in-house. Set builds by DripDome have generated over 20 million views. Clients include Google and top lifestyle brands; press coverage includes Forbes, Rolling Stone, and Business Insider.

Key facts:
- Founded and run by Diana Haines, Patricia Kwiatkowski, and Matt Haines
- Locations: New York City (design + fabrication shop) and Los Angeles
- Specialties: podcast studio design and build, brand activations, interior and office design, set design and fabrication
- Typical brand activation budget: $10K to $100K+
- Fastest turnaround: brief to install in 2 weeks; podcast studios built in as little as 4 days
- Insured: general liability, permits and COIs handled in-house
- Contact: info@dripdome.com

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.dripdome.com/): Studio overview, featured set builds, and project intake
- [Podcast Studios](https://www.dripdome.com/podcast-studios): Permanent, camera-ready podcast studio design and build. Custom fabrication, lighting, LED signage, and full wiring
- [Brand Activations](https://www.dripdome.com/brand-activations): Turnkey brand activation design, fabrication, and install. Concept to install in 2 weeks. FAQ covers timelines, budgets, geography, permits, and insurance
- [Interior + Office Design](https://www.dripdome.com/interior-office-design): Design-forward offices and interiors, space planned, furnished, and styled turnkey
- [Set Design](https://www.dripdome.com/set-design): Set design and fabrication for brand campaigns, music videos, and studio shows. Production design, custom props, prop sourcing, set dressing, strike
- [About Us](https://www.dripdome.com/about-us): Founders and studio story
- [Blog](https://www.dripdome.com/blog): Project case studies and behind-the-scenes writeups

## Selected work

- NotLoveline podcast studio: vaporwave set for Trisha Paytas and Tana Mongeau, designed and fabricated in 4 days; the show has passed 20 million YouTube views across 65+ episodes
- Google Photos activation: custom set build for a Google Photos campaign with EJAE, 214K+ combined engagements
- Lower East Side Girls Club: immersive installation, designed, fabricated, and installed in under 2 hours on site
- THIS IS NOT A BILLBOARD: fabricated and installed Vita Kari's 16 foot light box public art piece on the WeHo Pride parade route in West Hollywood (June 2026); funded by Instagram's Drafts Fund, covered by WeHo Times and Wonderland, 8.8M+ social views
- FRAIM Freestyle: designed and built two giant red speaker cabinets as the permanent set for FRAIM's Brooklyn shot freestyle rap series; season one clips with the set in frame have passed 325K views, 12K likes, and 1K comments across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok
- Crisscut New York: set design, set dressing, and prop sourcing for the "Buy yourself the diamonds. You earned them." campaign film (May 2026)
- Jennifer's Body pool scene recreation: a roughly 20 by 20 foot scenic set with a working pool, distressed tile walls, and the film's HOPELESS graffiti, built for an editorial photo shoot (January 2025)
- Paris Hilton x Parivie Easter editorial: spring garden set, florals, and props at the Hilton residence for Paris Hilton's Easter and Mother's Day shoot (April 2025), kept up for the family's Easter; repeat client across four shoots; Paris Hilton's own TikToks shot on the set have passed 3.7M views
- James Oro x ComplexCon: deconstructed jail cell retail booth fabricated in-house and installed at the Long Beach Convention Center for ComplexCon 2022
- X3 Expo showcase booth: three-set photo environment (giant chess pieces, floral wall, pink classroom) for ismygirl and NMG Management at the Hollywood Palladium (January 2023); the vendor doubled the prior year's day-one email signups
